sections.appearance: Kanna has long blonde hair with dog ears (similar to a German Shepherd) and sharp teeth. Her eyes are light blue with the right eye being covered by her bangs.
sections.halo: Kanna has a light blue halo made up of four cubes forming a cross-like shape.
sections.uniform: Kanna wears a police-like uniform consisting of a cyan dress shirt, a short dark blue tie, a police-like jacket, a dark blue police-like skirt, black thighs and short boots.
sections.personality: Kanna tends to be very serious and ruthless when it comes to solving problems, and she's aware of this. Without her meaning to, she tends to scare other people with her face. She also tries her best to not show her soft side to avoid criminals from looking down on her.
